records.name: Mohandas K. Gandhi
records.note: Existing POLITICA profile; relationships are interpretive and period-sensitive.

records.name: B. R. Ambedkar
records.note: Existing POLITICA profile; distinguish his own writings from later Ambedkarite movements.

records.name: Jawaharlal Nehru
records.note: Existing POLITICA profile; distinguish writings, party programmes and state practice.

records.name: Kautilya (Chanakya)
records.note: Classical political thinker; do not force a modern ideological label.

records.name: Rabindranath Tagore
records.note: Literary and political thinker; not reducible to a party ideology.

records.name: Bhagat Singh
records.note: Revolutionary and anti-colonial thinker; read dated writings.

records.name: Subhas Chandra Bose
records.note: Anti-colonial leader; evaluate political alliances and wartime context carefully.

records.name: M. N. Roy
records.note: His intellectual trajectory crossed several traditions; periodisation matters.

records.name: John Locke
records.note: Early modern political philosopher; avoid projecting contemporary party categories.

records.name: Mao Zedong
records.note: Political leader and theorist; distinguish doctrine from governing outcomes.

records.name: Nelson Mandela
records.note: Anti-apartheid leader and president; not a single fixed ideological score.
